QuestInfo.name: [Evolution System] Where Is Orchid?
QuestInfo.0: Claudine says Orchid has disappeared. She can't possibly use any of her powers... Where could she have gone? Talk to Claudine for more details.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine says you must figure out Orchid's whereabouts again. You can only think of one place when she asks for any leads--the #rEvolution Lab#k. You have a feeling Orchid must be there.
QuestInfo.2: As expected Orchid was at the Evolution Lab. She mistook ESS for Lotus. She was furious when she found out ESS was an artificial intelligence with only Lotus's appearance copied over.
